name: Diploma Interior Design
title: Diploma in Interior Design
intro: The interior design diploma roadmap: admission, studio and software training, site exposure and jobs.

phases.title: Eligibility
phases.summary: Class 10 or 12 pass in any stream.
points: Interior design diplomas are offered by polytechnics and design institutes.
Sketching, colour sense and spatial imagination help.
Observe homes, shops and public spaces.
Start a sketchbook.

phases.title: Admission process
points: Apply to polytechnics through the state portal or to private institutes directly.
Take any aptitude or drawing test required.
Compare studios, software labs and industry tie-ups.
Complete admission.

phases.title: Design fundamentals
points: Learn drawing, perspective, colour and design principles.
Study building materials and basic construction.
Learn model making.
Study history of interiors.

phases.title: Space planning and software
points: Learn space planning, lighting, furniture design and services.
Learn AutoCAD, SketchUp, 3ds Max and rendering.
Do studio projects for homes, offices and retail.
Learn costing and client presentations.

phases.title: Site training and careers
phases.summary: Training on projects, then jobs or your own studio.
points: Intern with interior design firms and visit live sites.
Roles: junior designer, 3D visualiser, site supervisor and design assistant.
Further study: B.Des or advanced programmes.
Start your own practice after experience.
